**Do not report security vulnerabilities here.** See [SECURITY.md](../../SECURITY.md)
for private disclosure.

## Description
A clear and concise description of the bug.

## Steps to reproduce
1. Go to '...'
2. Click on '...'
3. See error

## Expected behavior
What you expected to happen.

## Actual behavior
What actually happened. Include the **correlation ID** from the error response
if one was shown.

## Environment
- Deployment: [Docker / local dev]
- Backend: [output of `uv run python --version`]
- Browser (if frontend): [e.g. Chrome 124]

## Logs / screenshots
Paste relevant server log lines (redact any secrets) or screenshots. Never paste
API keys, tokens, or `.env` contents.
